answer: Reciprocal audit grove. Each identity must hold an independently earned reputation delta from at least two non-affiliated peers before transacting; new clones start at zero and cannot inherit it. Any identity that only transacts with clones in its own cluster is flagged and frozen. An attacker therefore pays a full onboarding cost per clone while each clone yields no usable trust, making the marginal copy strictly negative-EV. Nodes also post a small ferrous token deposit returned only after 30 days of verified clean activity.
